title: A ``TenantScopedMixin`` model's service must extend ``TenantScopedService``
intent: This makes tenant isolation structural on the **write** side: reads of a tenant-scoped model are already filtered centrally by the registered tenant scope predicate (ADR 0017), but ``TenantScopedService`` is what stamps ``tenant_id`` on create — so a plain ``BaseService`` (which would insert an unstamped, never-visible row) is rejected at build time.
